trace.query: How much does a Tide Canteen meal cost in harbor credits?

retrieved_chunks.title: East Canteen
retrieved_chunks.text:
andard meal at the East Canteen costs 3 harbor credits; a large portion costs 4.

Allergy board: peanuts are used in the Monday braise. The Wednesday dumplings here are pan-fried, not steamed.

The East Canteen accepts harbor credits and will also accept a shuttle day pass as payment.

retrieved_chunks.title: East Canteen
retrieved_chunks.text:
East Canteen weekly menu notes

Monday: congee and salted duck egg (breakfast); beef noodle soup (lunch).
Wednesday: dumplings are served at both lunch and dinner. Pork and chive filling, with a mushroom option.
Friday: clam chowder. The East Canteen kitchen closes at 20:00 on Fridays, the same as every other weekday.

A standard meal at the East Canteen costs 3 harbor credits; a large portion costs 4.

retrieved_chunks.title: Tide Canteen
retrieved_chunks.text:
is used in the Friday chili oil. The Wednesday dumplings are steamed, not fried.

Payment is harbor credits only. The canteen does not accept the shuttle day pass.

retrieved_chunks.title: Tideline Shuttle
retrieved_chunks.text:
Harbor Institute shuttle loop

The campus shuttle is named the Tideline. On weekdays it runs every 12 minutes from 07:30 to 19:30. Weekend service is every 25 minutes from 09:00 to 17:00.

Stops in order: Gatehouse, Library Plaza, North Jetty Lab, Tide Canteen, Staff Housing, Gatehouse.

A single ride costs 1 harbor credit. Faculty and students tap the same blue card used for the library. Visitors buy a paper day pass at the Gatehouse, not on the bus.

retrieved_chunks.title: Tide Canteen
retrieved_chunks.text:
Tide Canteen weekly menu notes

Monday: millet porridge and pickled greens (breakfast); tomato egg noodles (lunch).
Wednesday: the canteen serves dumplings only at lunch, 11:30–13:30. The filling is fennel and tofu; no meat option that day.
Friday: fish-cake soup. The kitchen closes at 19:00 on Fridays, one hour earlier than other weekdays.

Allergy board: sesame is used in the Friday chili oil. The Wednesday dumplings are steamed, not fried.

retrieved_chunks.title: Harbor Library
retrieved_chunks.text:
Harbor Institute Library hours (term time)

Monday to Thursday: 08:00–21:00
Friday: 08:00–18:00
Saturday: 10:00–16:00
Sunday: closed

The quiet study floor is Level 3. Group rooms on Level 1 must be booked in the Harbor Desk app at least two hours ahead. Food is not allowed except bottled water.

The late-return fine is 2 harbor credits per day, capped at 40 credits per item. Course reserves cannot leave the building.

retrieved_chunks.title: Tideline Winter Recess
retrieved_chunks.text:
teen, Gatehouse. North Jetty Lab and Staff Housing are not served during recess.

A single ride still costs 1 harbor credit. Recess day passes are sold at the Gatehouse only, and the Gatehouse desk itself opens at 07:45.

Recess dates are published by the department office each year and are not listed here.

retrieved_chunks.title: Saltmarsh Annex Library
retrieved_chunks.text:
Saltmarsh Annex Library hours (term time)

Monday to Friday: 09:00–17:00
Saturday: closed
Sunday: 12:00–18:00

The Annex is a separate building from the Harbor Institute Library and keeps its own schedule. The quiet study floor here is Level 2. There are no group rooms; readers who need one should book at the Harbor Desk instead.

The late-return fine at the Annex is 1 harbor credit per day, capped at 25 credits per item. Bottled water and covered cups are both allowed.

retrieved_chunks.title: Saltmarsh Annex Library
retrieved_chunks.text:
capped at 25 credits per item. Bottled water and covered cups are both allowed.

Annex reserves may be borrowed for 48 hours and may leave the building.

retrieved_chunks.title: Tideline Winter Recess
retrieved_chunks.text:
Tideline shuttle: winter recess schedule

During winter recess the Tideline runs a reduced loop: every 30 minutes from 08:00 to 18:00, every day including weekends. Normal term-time frequencies do not apply during recess.

The recess loop skips two stops. Stops served: Gatehouse, Library Plaza, Tide Canteen, Gatehouse. North Jetty Lab and Staff Housing are not served during recess.

retrieved_chunks.title: Coastal Memory Group
retrieved_chunks.text:
Coastal Memory Group (fictional research unit)

The Coastal Memory Group studies how harbor towns archive storm records. The group office is Room 214 in the East Archive wing. Weekly seminar: Thursday 16:00–17:00 in Seminar Hut B.

Current working corpus (internal nickname: Salt Ledger) contains 48 digitized logbooks from 1912–1938. The group does not hold records after 1940.

retrieved_chunks.title: Storm Ledger Unit
retrieved_chunks.text:
te and are the unit's most requested series. The unit holds nothing before 1940.

Lead archivist: Ana Ferreira. Student liaison: Tom Baptiste. Interview requests go to ledger@harbor-institute.example.

The unit's fact sheet records that the 1948 "Black Mast Gale" lasted 19 hours in Harbor Town. The unit does not hold material on the 1921 Green Lamp Flood and refers those enquiries elsewhere.

The late-return fine at the Annex is 1 harbor credit per day, capped at 25 credits per item. Bottled water and covered cups are both allowed.

chunks.title: Tideline Winter Recess
chunks.text:
Tideline shuttle: winter recess schedule

During winter recess the Tideline runs a reduced loop: every 30 minutes from 08:00 to 18:00, every day including weekends. Normal term-time frequencies do not apply during recess.

The recess loop skips two stops. Stops served: Gatehouse, Library Plaza, Tide Canteen, Gatehouse. North Jetty Lab and Staff Housing are not served during recess.

chunks.title: Coastal Memory Group
chunks.text:
Coastal Memory Group (fictional research unit)

The Coastal Memory Group studies how harbor towns archive storm records. The group office is Room 214 in the East Archive wing. Weekly seminar: Thursday 16:00–17:00 in Seminar Hut B.

Current working corpus (internal nickname: Salt Ledger) contains 48 digitized logbooks from 1912–1938. The group does not hold records after 1940.

Lead archivist: Ana Ferreira. Student liaison: Tom Baptiste. Interview requests go to ledger@harbor-institute.example.

The unit's fact sheet records that the 1948 "Black Mast Gale" lasted 19 hours in Harbor Town. The unit does not hold material on the 1921 Green Lamp Flood and refers those enquiries elsewhere.
